deadline.value: No deadline: professors recruit doctoral students throughout the year, so apply whenever a position is open.
deadline.quote: There are no deadlines for submitting the registration for the doctorate, as the professors recruit their candidates throughout the year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: An ETH professor must agree to supervise you; check the research groups and contact professors about open positions.
supervisor.quote: In addition, a professor at ETH Zurich must be willing to supervise the doctoral thesis. | we advise you to have a look at the overview of research groups and contact the professors to inquire about available open positions

funding.value: Most D-MATL doctoral students are employed by ETH or another ETH Domain institution such as Empa or PSI.
funding.quote: They are registered as students and in most cases, they are employed at ETH Zurich or one of the institutions of the ETH Domain, for example Empa or PSI.

entry_route.value: A university diploma or Master's degree recognised by ETH is required.
entry_route.quote: The condition for admission to the doctorate at ETH Zurich is a university diploma or Master's degree recognized by ETH.

notes: Doctoral students are typically associated with the voluntary MaP Doctoral School.
